enriched_steps.what_changes: For each source-labelled trajectory, serialize the ordered prefix H_t as a fixed-schema record containing source-coordinate s, measurement positions, timestamps, wind/context channels, validity masks, and gas readings up to t. Create one positive record (s,H_t) for every observed source-prefix pair. Create the product-of-marginals records by sampling a source from a different trajectory within the same declared context stratum and pairing it with H_t; reject self-pairs and preserve the empirical source and history counts. Draw equal numbers of positive and negative records, and store split, stratum, trajectory_id, prefix_id, and pairing_type so every later control is reproducible.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Encode every trajectory prefix as one fixed-schema record with the source coordinate, ordered positions and timestamps, wind or context variables, validity masks, and gas readings seen so far. Keep the source label attached to the trajectory that generated the prefix for a matched example. Make a negative example by taking a source from a different trajectory in the same context stratum and pairing it with the prefix; forbid self-pairs and retain identifiers for the split, stratum, trajectory, prefix, and pairing type. Sample equal numbers of matched and negative records and write the resulting table as the training input for the scorer.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把每条轨迹前缀编码成固定字段记录：源点坐标、有序的位置和时间戳、风场或上下文变量、有效性掩码，以及截至当前时刻的气体读数。matched example 保留生成该前缀的轨迹源标签。negative example 从同一 context stratum 的另一条轨迹抽取源点与该前缀配对，禁止自配对，并保存 split、stratum、trajectory、prefix 和 pairing type 等标识。对 matched 和 negative 等量抽样，将表格作为 scorer 的训练输入。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Implement D_theta(s,H_t) as a shared encoder: a coordinate/context encoder for s, a masked sequence encoder for the ordered H_t, and a bilinear or concatenated head whose weights are shared for every candidate. Use balanced binary cross-entropy, apply inverse source-frequency weights only when correcting a declared sampling imbalance, and calibrate the held-out logit with a monotone calibration fit learned on a separate calibration split. Emit one logit and one calibration diagnostic for every candidate-prefix pair; no candidate-index embedding or source-specific head may be present.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Build one scorer shared by all candidates. Encode the candidate coordinate and the masked ordered history with separate encoders, combine the two embeddings with a bilinear or concatenation head, and use the same weights for every source location. Train with balanced binary cross-entropy; only use inverse-frequency weights when the recorded sampler is imbalanced. Fit a monotone calibration map on a separate calibration split and emit a logit plus calibration diagnostics for each candidate and prefix. Do not add a candidate-index embedding or a source-specific output head.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 构造一个对所有候选共享的 scorer：用独立编码器处理候选坐标和带 mask 的有序历史，再用双线性或拼接 head 融合；所有源点必须共用同一组权重。训练使用平衡二元交叉熵；只有在记录到采样失衡时才使用逆源频率权重。用独立 calibration split 拟合单调校准映射，并为每个候选-前缀输出 logit 与校准诊断。禁止 candidate-index embedding 和 source-specific output head。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Evaluate the calibrated scorer on an independently paired product-control table and compute the exponential ratio moment with numerically stabilized logits; record its estimate and confidence interval before accepting ratio interpretation. For each intact prefix, add the frozen PMFS prior log pi_0(s) to the calibrated logit, subtract the log-sum-exp over the complete frozen source grid, and write q_theta(s|H_t) together with normalization residual, prior version, and split identifiers.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: First evaluate the calibrated scorer on a product-control table that was not used for fitting. Compute the exponential ratio moment with stabilized logits and record its estimate and uncertainty before treating the logits as ratios. For every intact prefix, add the frozen PMFS prior in log space, normalize with a log-sum-exp over every source in the frozen grid, and save the probability map, normalization residual, prior version, and split identifiers.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 先在未参与拟合的 product-control 表上评估校准后的 scorer。对数值稳定的 logit 计算 exponential ratio moment，并在把 logit 解释成 ratio 之前保存估计值和不确定性。对每个完整前缀，在 log 空间加入冻结的 PMFS 先验，用完整冻结源网格上的 log-sum-exp 归一化，保存概率图、归一化残差、先验版本和 split 标识。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Choose the true source s* from the trajectory label and choose fixed rivals before reading the model output using a pre-registered rule: the nearest non-true grid candidate and the highest-prior non-true candidate, with ties resolved by grid order. Store logits for every prefix, calculate consecutive differences for s* and each rival, subtract the rival increment from the true increment, and accumulate from t=1; report the final rank and margin with bootstrap intervals over trajectories.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Set the true source from the trajectory label and choose rivals before inspecting predictions: use the nearest wrong grid candidate and the highest-prior wrong candidate, breaking ties by grid order. Save the logit for every prefix, difference adjacent prefixes, subtract each rival's increment from the true-source increment, and accumulate from the first prefix. Report per-update margins, cumulative margins, final rank, and trajectory-bootstrap intervals.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 由轨迹标签确定真实源点，并在查看预测前按预注册规则选择错误候选：最近的错误网格点和先验最高的错误网格点，平局按网格顺序处理。保存每个前缀的 logit，计算相邻前缀差分，用真实源点增量减去每个 rival 增量，从第一个前缀开始累加。报告每次更新 margin、累计 margin、最终 rank，以及按轨迹 bootstrap 得到的区间。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For the equivariance check, apply one recorded bijection to the candidate grid, rerun the same scorer without retraining, inverse-permute the resulting map, and record the maximum absolute residual and rank agreement. For the destructive controls, keep each measurement value and marginal count unchanged while (i) reassigning readings to different time-position slots within a prefix and (ii) pairing sources with histories from other trajectories within the same stratum. Recompute S1-S4 with frozen model and splits, and store intact and control traces plus the predeclared pass/fail thresholds.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For the symmetry test, apply a recorded one-to-one relabeling of the source grid, run the same trained scorer without retraining, inverse-relabel the output, and record the largest absolute residual and rank agreement. For the two destructive controls, keep all readings and marginal counts but reassign readings to different time-position slots, and separately pair sources with histories from other trajectories in the same stratum. Re-run the full scoring and evidence calculation with the model and splits frozen, saving intact and control traces and the predeclared pass/fail thresholds.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对等变性检查，给候选源网格施加一一重标记，在不重新训练的情况下运行同一个 scorer，再把输出逆置换，记录最大绝对残差和 rank 是否一致。两个破坏性 control 都保持读数和边际计数不变：一个把读数重新分配到不同的时间-位置槽位，另一个在同一 stratum 内把源点与其他轨迹历史重新配对。冻结模型和 split，重新执行完整评分与证据计算，保存 intact/control 轨迹以及预注册的通过/失败阈值。
